end.line: Quillon for Belmont Croft’s regulatory team

vo: Belmont Croft’s regulatory team answers about one hundred and fifty enforcement inquiries a year, with productions of thirty thousand documents.
Quillon builds the chronology from the production, and every event links back to its source document.
Ask what the board knew and when, and the answer comes back cited to the exact page.
Quillon reviews every document in the production at once, flagging the ones the regulator asked for.
Fiona will walk your team through it on Friday the twenty-seventh.
